lines: 23:04:58  Archos › pray I know the world will not let me, but if I could I would sit here and watch the time pass and the beasts move and enjoy what exists.
23:04:58  Archos prays: “I know the world will not let me, but if I could I would sit here and watch the time pass and the beasts move and enjoy what exists.”

items.args: {"target": "character", "id": "a4e99ff8a7d2", "text": "Nothing stops you. Sit as long as you like — the beasts will keep moving whether or not you tell them to."}

items.text: Replied to Archos's prayer at the Rise, telling her nothing actually stops her from just sitting and watching — no other changes to note.
